reason: No proposal addresses line length or flake8 configuration. Only 11 lines over 120 chars across ~830 files in platypush/ and tests/, nearly all long URLs in docstrings or comments.
No proposal covers docstring format. About 300 files use RST fields (~4,650 ':param' lines), and Google-style section headers appear in only 2 files.

D-84701e requires only the *Plugin suffix, not the <Module> prefix derived from the module path, so it is weaker. All 163 plugin __init__ modules that define a *Plugin class have one whose name matches the CamelCase module path.
No proposal covers backend class naming. All 4 backend __init__ modules that define a *Backend class have one matching the CamelCase module path.

No proposal concerns manifest.json dependencies. 153 plugin and 5 backend manifests declare install deps. The sampled third-party imports are either declared (phue, py-trello) or core requirements (zeroconf, websocket-client). A few concrete plugins, such as mail/smtp, have no manifest of their own.
No proposal covers line length. Only 11 lines over 120 chars repo-wide, all in platypush/ and mostly URLs; none outside platypush/ and tests/.

No proposal concerns bugbear checks. grep finds no mutable default arguments and no assert False. The only bare excepts are inside embedded MicroPython code strings in esp, and a few noqa B026/B010 suppressions exist.
No proposal concerns comprehension checks. Heuristic greps find few unnecessary list/dict/set calls (e.g. one dict(k=...) call, one noqa C416).
No proposal concerns flake8-simplify. Code is largely clean, with a few SIM118-style 'for x in d.keys()' loops (irc/_bot.py, trello, zigbee/mqtt).
